verify.note: Closed 2026-09-30 (ADR-1684). Measures the consequences in-process: runs lib/movement.ts, lib/on-air.ts, lib/practices/tiers.ts and lib/on-air/dispatch-copy.ts under --experimental-strip-types (about 0.2 s). A walk, run and stretch with a 10 minute target bank all 1080 s of an 18 minute run and 1020 s on a resume (6 min banked + 11 now), their overtime clock reads 125 s at 725 s and 0 before the target; yoga and strength keep their plan cap; movement-session.tsx banks Stop and the unattended finalize through movementFinishSeconds, no longer caps with Math.min(done, finishCap), and renders overtimeAt and liveDepthCue; the Be Still sit still renders liveDepthCue; liveDepthCue(10 min) reads Standard with 5 minutes to Heavy. fallbackSessionDispatch leads the cached line with the opener for walk, sit, flow, run and (template) stretch and keeps its button; completeSession builds the fallback with fallbackSessionDispatch(dispatchKind, ...) and checks movementMode with MOVEMENT_MODES.some; cleanDispatchCopy rejects a voiced sit or walk its fact did not name and passes a faithful rephrase and a fact-named activity; voiceCopy hands the fact to cleanDispatchCopy; lib/vera-dispatch.ts code carries no Deep. Fails on main (451c500f0) at the first arm (lib/movement.ts has no autoContinues). Mutation-fired: 19 of 19 arm mutations fail it. Exits 1 with the file name when a wired file is gone. The per-mode preview walkthrough is manual and is NOT measured here; its click path is in the detail.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1684). RE-TESTED on main at 451c500f0 before building (ADR-1082); two of the three arms were still open. (1) AUTO-CONTINUE FOR TIMED MOVEMENT, PREMISE HELD: components/on-air/movement-session.tsx capped Stop and the unattended finalize at finishCap (Math.min(done, finishCap)), and past the end the screen showed a dimmed 0:00 and "Done", so a 10 minute walk kept going to 18 minutes banked 10. BUILT: lib/movement.ts AUTO_CONTINUE_MODES (walk, run, stretch, the "duration-based Movement" scope of IDEA-007), autoContinues, overtimeAt and movementFinishSeconds (pure). A Walk, Run or Stretch banks the whole run, including a resume's earlier partial. Past the target the clock reads +M:SS, the line reads "Going deeper", and the shared tier cue sits under it. liveDepthCue moved from session.tsx to lib/practices/tiers.ts, and both timers call that one copy. Yoga and Strength keep the plan-bounded cap, and Play banks raw. The run-over gate (ADR-627) still clamps an unattended run at 150% of target. The error-screen retry now replays the failed finish's exact seconds, so the uncapped count cannot add the time spent on the error screen. (2) VERA FALLBACK, PREMISE HELD: when both reveal state reads fail, completeSession showed the cached daily Dispatch with no opener, and that line is minted once a day and replayed after every session, from an AI voice told nothing about the activity. The depth_mark template also said "hits N Deep", a retired name. BUILT: lib/on-air.ts fallbackSessionDispatch leads the cached line (or the steady template) with THIS session's dispatchOpener, and completeSession uses it. cleanDispatchCopy(raw, fact) (now in the import-free lib/on-air/dispatch-copy.ts) rejects a voiced line that names an activity its fact did not, so the template stands, and the prompt says the same thing. dispatchKindFor checks movementMode against MOVEMENT_MODES. depth_mark now reads "reaches N logs". (3) PER-MODE LIVE WALKTHROUGH ON A PREVIEW (PD7-2): NOT WALKED. It needs a signed-in member on a deployed preview, and no code in this change can do it. What a human clicks on this PR's Vercel preview, as a member with at least one adopted timed practice: (a) Open Mindless from the Zap button (or /on-air). Choose Be Still, Meditate, set the stepper to 3, tap Start Practice, and let it run past zero. The clock should read +0:xx with "You're at Light. 2 more minutes reaches Standard." under it. Tap Finish. The Stats card should read "This sit" with "You reached Light.", and the Dispatch should open "Good sit." (b) Repeat with Breathe (any pattern) at 3 minutes. The rings keep breathing past the target, "Going deeper +M:SS" shows, and after Finish the Dispatch opens "Nice breathing." (c) Switch to Get Moving, choose Walk, set 3 minutes, and start. At 3:00 the end chime rings once, and the ring should NOT dim. The clock should read +0:xx with "Going deeper" and "You're at Light. 2 more minutes reaches Standard." under it. Keep it running to about +2:10, so the cue flips to "You're at Standard." Tap Finish. The Stats card should read "This walk" with "You reached Standard.", and the Dispatch should open "Nice walk.". This is the new auto-continue. (d) Choose Yoga (the Vinyasa preset, or any flow). At the end it should dim and read "Done" with no +M:SS. Finish reads "This yoga", and the Dispatch opens "Nice flow.". (e) Partial path: start a Walk at 10 minutes and tap Stop & Log after 5:10. The reveal should say 1 Zap, and the practice should then read Continue Practice with the streak held. The fallback Dispatch (both state reads failing) cannot be forced on a preview; it is covered by app/(main)/on-air/actions.test.ts and lib/on-air.test.ts. No migration.
